name: @actovision/facebook-conversion-api-nodejs
description: Node.js / TypeScript client for Meta's Conversions API (CAPI). FacebookCapiClient with full parameter coverage (user_data, app_data, referrer_url, LDU/CCPA, offline events), automatic SHA-256 hashing + normalization, batching up to 1000 events per request, exponential-backoff retries. Graph API v22.0, zero runtime dependencies.
author: Actovision

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run test -- --run && pnpm run build
